_note: SYNTHETIC scenario. No survivor identity is recorded anywhere (BNS 2023 s.72). Tests the BNSS s.184 statutory floor, cold chain and custody-deadline logic.
title: Sexual assault in a lodge room — clinical and scene exhibits
description:
Ex-S1: sexual assault evidence kit (vaginal swabs, smears) collected at the government hospital, kept at room temperature in the ward
Ex-S2: undergarments of the survivor packed in a plastic bag, damp
Ex-S3: bedsheet with suspected semen stains from the lodge room
Ex-S4: used condom recovered from the dustbin of the room
Ex-S5: 3 strands of hair on the pillow
Ex-S6: clothes of the accused seized at the instance of the accused
Ex-S7: mobile phone of the accused
Ex-S8: CCTV of the lodge corridor and reception, not yet seized
Ex-S9: drinking glass on the side table
Ex-S10: blood sample of the accused on FTA card for DNA reference
